display.purpose: Dialog/section titles and the MAS CARE wordmark only.

body.purpose: All working UI text: labels, tables, forms, chips.

shadows.name: card-hint
shadows.purpose: The only shadow allowed on a resting, non-overlay surface (selected dashboard metric).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The only button that should anchor a form or primary flow.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #ffffff; background: var(--tealmax, #0e7c86); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); border: none; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--petroleo, #0a3d4a); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px var(--tealmax, #0e7c86); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Default button for anything that isn't the primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink, #173c44); background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid var(--borde, #e3eef0); transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--fondo, #f4f9fa); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px var(--tealmax, #0e7c86); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Icon-only chrome: close buttons, menu toggles.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-ghost" aria-label="Cerrar"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><line x1="18" y1="6" x2="6" y2="18"/><line x1="6" y1="6" x2="18" y2="18"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; width: 40px; padding: 0; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--muted, #71878c); background: transparent; border: none; transition: color 0.15s ease, background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--ink, #173c44); background: #ffffff; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px var(--tealmax, #0e7c86); }

components.name: Danger Button
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #991b1b; background: #fef2f2; border: 1px solid #fecaca; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: #fee2e2; }

components.name: Coral Button
components.description: A second, sparingly-used "do this now" affordance, distinct from primary teal.
components.css: .ds-btn-coral { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #ffffff; background: var(--coral, #ff8a5b); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); border: none; transition: background-color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-coral:hover { background: rgba(255, 138, 91, 0.9); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Labeled input with teal focus ring and red error state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink, #173c44); } .ds-field-input { height: 40px; width: 100%; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid var(--borde, #e3eef0); background: #ffffff; color: var(--ink, #173c44); font-size: 14px; outline: none; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-field-input:focus { border-color: var(--tealmax, #0e7c86); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(14,124,134,0.15); } .ds-field-input[aria-invalid="true"] { border-color: #f87171; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: The only place a derived treatment status may render a color; mirrors the API's derived_status.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid transparent; padding: 4px 10px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip[data-status="al-dia"] { background: #ecfdf5; color: #064e3b; border-color: #a7f3d0; } .ds-chip[data-status="proxima-reposicion"] { background: #f0f9ff; color: #0c4a6e; border-color: #bae6fd; } .ds-chip[data-status="vence-pronto"] { background: #fffbeb; color: #451a03; border-color: #fde68a; } .ds-chip[data-status="retiro-pendiente"] { background: #f5f3ff; color: #4c1d95; border-color: #ddd6fe; } .ds-chip[data-status="vencido"] { background: var(--expired-bg, #fdecea); color: var(--expired-text, #8e1b1b); border-color: var(--expired-border, #f5b5b0); } .ds-chip[data-status="receta-por-renovar"] { background: #f1f5f9; color: #1e293b; border-color: #cbd5e1; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The default white, bordered, flat container used for every section and list panel.
components.html:
Pacientes activos

128 pacientes con cobertura vigente.
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--borde, #e3eef0); background: #ffffff; padding: 20px; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--petroleo, #0a3d4a); } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted, #71878c); }

components.name: Dialog
components.description: The one surface in the system allowed a heavy shadow; title uses the display font.
components.html:
Confirmar entrega

Contenido del diálogo.
components.css: .ds-dialog { width: 100%; max-width: 560px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--borde, #e3eef0); background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); } .ds-dialog-header { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--borde, #e3eef0); padding: 20px 24px; } .ds-dialog-title { margin: 0; font-family: 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--petroleo, #0a3d4a); } .ds-dialog-close { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #71878c); cursor: pointer; } .ds-dialog-close:hover { color: var(--ink, #173c44); background: #ffffff; } .ds-dialog-body { padding: 20px 24px; overflow-y: auto; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Signature component: the dark petrol command sidebar with teal/white active states.
components.html: TableroReportes
components.css: .ds-sidebar { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 256px; background: var(--petroleo, #0a3d4a); padding: 16px; border-radius: 12px; } .ds-sidebar-link { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-sidebar-link:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.08); color: #ffffff; } .ds-sidebar-link--active { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color: #ffffff; }

narrative.overview: MAS CARE is where a pharmacy watches every patient's medication coverage the way a control room watches a fleet: calm at rest, precise about what needs a human in the next hour. The system stays flat and quiet by default so that the one derived status that actually changes an action — vence pronto, vencido, próxima reposición — is the only thing that visually asserts itself. Nothing is decorative; color, radius, and weight are all spent on legibility and on surfacing what's due. The mood is calm & trustworthy: deep clinical teal and petrol for structure and action, a single reassurance green held in reserve, and coral/red used narrowly so an overdue patient actually reads as urgent rather than one alert among many. Density is built for staff moving through many patients per shift, but nothing is cramped: borders and whitespace do the organizing, not shadows.
keyCharacteristics: Flat, bordered surfaces at rest; real shadows reserved for things that float above the page (dialogs, menus, toasts).
One accent (tealmax) carries every primary action and every focus ring — it is never used for decoration.
Status color is never invented in a component; it always traces back to the API's derived status map.
Display font (Manrope, bold) only on titles and the wordmark; DM Sans carries all working text.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Tealmax is the only color allowed to mean "act here." If a second color starts carrying primary actions, the hierarchy has broken.

rules.name: The Status-Is-Not-Decoration Rule
rules.body: A status color only ever comes from StatusChip's status map (mirroring the API's derived_status). No component recomputes or re-interprets status color independently.

rules.name: The Display-Is-Rare Rule
rules.body: Manrope appears only on titles and the wordmark. Everything a user scans quickly — tables, forms, chips — stays in DM Sans so the two fonts never compete for the same job.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface earns a real shadow only by floating above the page (dialog, menu, toast). Everything else reads through its border and background, not its shadow.

dos: Do keep tealmax exclusive to primary actions and focus rings (The One Accent Rule).
Do drive status color only through StatusChip's map, matching the API's derived_status (The Status-Is-Not-Decoration Rule).
Do use shadow-card (4% tint) at most — never a heavier shadow — on a surface that sits flat on the page.
Do reserve Manrope/font-display for titles and the wordmark; everything else is DM Sans.
donts: Don't add shadow-lg/shadow-xl/shadow-2xl to a resting card, section, or table — those are for dialogs, menus, and toasts only.
Don't introduce a second "primary" accent color; coral and danger-red are narrow exceptions, not alternatives to tealmax.
Don't recompute a patient's status color client-side; it must come from the API's derived status, surfaced only through StatusChip.
Don't use cuidado (reassurance green) for a button or large fill — it is reserved for the wordmark icon and the sidebar scrollbar tint.
